title: Helmet Rental for Snowbasin and Powder Mountain
includes: Park City or Deer Valley shop pick-up (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Same price for adults and juniors
policies: Pick up the night before you ski or ride and drop off the morning after your final rental day.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Protect your noggin with an adult or junior rental helmet. Whether you rent the rest of your equipment from us or have your own, it's important to make sure your lid is covered. Rental period is 24 hours.
